name: Common Room
desc1: This quiet, comfortable inn speaks of good food and restful sleep.
desc2: Warm light glows from lit lanterns and candles, and a pleasant warmth
desc3: from the fireplace fills the air. Two large round tables sit in the
desc4: centre of the room, and a dozen waiting chairs encircle them. In one
desc5: chair in the corner is a strange man, who by the look of it appears to
desc6: be the owner of this place. A small arch leads into the kitchen to the
desc7: west, and a large one leads to foyer to the south.
